packageRules.description: Group all Go module updates into one PR
Group all GitHub Actions updates into one PR
Pin the Go base image in the Containerfile using docker versioning

Restate the preset's go-toolchain group after the gomod grouping above. Rules in this file are evaluated after the preset, so the broad gomod rule would otherwise pull the go directive back into the go-modules PR and leave the golang base image behind in a separate one. A directive ahead of the image makes go mod download fail inside it.
